metadata.title: Cyberpunk Metropolis Quest
metadata.author: Paul Peter (@asterixh)
metadata.description: A bustling, multi-layered side-scrolling cyberpunk metropolis platformer world with 72 parallax skylines, illuminated megastructures, street overpasses, animated patrolling police, vendor stalls, and hero characters.
